component.name: XP Notepad
component.summary: A plain-text editor styled after Windows XP Notepad

description.p: XP Notepad is an unofficial recreation of the classic Windows XP Notepad, drawn entirely in Flutter. It opens, edits and saves plain text files, with Find, Replace, Go To, Time and Date, word wrap, font choice, and light and dark modes.
This is an independent implementation and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
